# OfTheDay.net

> A daily Morning Meeting planner for K-12 teachers. Each day it builds a Greeting, a Sharing prompt, a Group Activity and a Morning Message for the teacher's grade band, with Word of the Day, Do Now warm-ups, On This Day facts and an AI lesson slide maker. It collects no student data.

## Pricing (as published on the homepage)
- Free: daily routine, basic activity library, 3 saved routines, 5 AI lesson slides per month. No credit card.
- Pro Teacher: $79 per year, or $9 per month. Full library, projector mode, unlimited AI lesson slides, cloud sync.
- School: $199 per year, up to 50 teacher accounts, one invoice. District licensing is quoted on request.
